tbca_target.name: Feijoada vegetariana, c/ sal, Brasil
tbca_target.standardized_preparation_description: black beans, vegetable broth, eggplant, bell pepper, potato, carrot, chayote, green beans, zucchini, soybean oil, onion, garlic, and salt

profile_eligibility.basis: the official TBCA ingredient description lists only plant-derived ingredients and reports 0 g animal protein per 100 g

profile_recipe_evidence.decision: The standardized BRC0172T preparation is compatible with the vegan profile; this does not verify the actual generated recipe or API prompt provenance.

limitations: This decision applies to TBCA code BRC0172T and its listed standardized recipe, not every dish named vegetarian feijoada.
